      Still in development

      VALORSTRIKE

      A VALORANT style shooter that runs in a browser. What you are looking at is real: the lobby, the bots, the Spike and the retake all run right here, and more modes are on the way.

      A fan project made for the love of the game. Not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.

      Patch notes · 10 Oct

      What's new

      • Weekly board: your XP this week, reset every Monday.
      • All-time badges: earned once, kept forever on your profile.
      • Ranked Retake: 3v3 on Ascent B site, with rank points per match.
      • Rifle 2v2 Ranked: Vandal and Phantom only, first to 4.
      • Your profile: kills, deaths and wins in one place.
      • Settings for sensitivity, volume, brightness, FPS, crosshair color and bot difficulty.
      • Inventory with weapon skins for every weapon and the knife.

      Saved on this device only

      Profile

      Level 10 XP

      Your XP this week, saved on this device only - no global leaderboard yet. Resets Monday.

        Get the app

        Add VALORSTRIKE to your Home Screen

        A website can't hide the browser's bars on iPhone. From your Home Screen VALORSTRIKE opens full screen, like an app.

        1. 1 · ShareTap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.
        2. 2 · Add to Home ScreenScroll the menu and pick Add to Home Screen, then Add.
        3. 3 · OpenTap the VALORSTRIKE icon. It opens full screen.
